method.description: Actually visually inspected four chronological sheets using view_image, every fourth frame plus last, against individually viewed exact-hash approved source. FFmpeg decoding limited to two CPU threads; no GPU submission or painting processor. Live Comfy history verified successful generation.

observations: Seal makes repeated front-flipper clapping/paddling motions while gently balancing the colored ball on its nose; meaningful movement is visible without large travel.
Two front flippers and the source rear-flipper arrangement remain attached and coherent. Head, muzzle, eye and gray torso retain source appearance; no solid extra limbs or anatomical loss observed.

Some late clapping samples around frames 100-112 show faint motion trails/soft doubled edges on the moving flippers. Frame 104 was additionally inspected individually at native resolution: this reads as motion smear, not a separate limb or structural mutation.
Ball retains its red/yellow/green/cyan/blue/purple panels and round silhouette, stays at the nose, and remains fully below the upper image boundary. No added face appears on the ball.
Pink flipper coloring, rear flippers and blue oval below the seal persist. Full seal and ball remain uncropped in all sampled frames; no disappearing decorations observed.
limitations: Sampled visual inspection is not realtime playback or inspection of every frame. Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of inter-sample artifacts or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
